title: Page 168
transc:
Ft Monroe May 29 . 1864
Maj Eckert Di
from Burr Moody hundreds may harsh pony plug
feeble am peasant animal harrow padlock Cornelia for
Indian Unity Shelby Ames with pension purple spit
and plunge pagan will leave here at daylight
Whelp morning to hold the patent at while
house and Saffron his vesper zodiac The other
whinny will follow as fast as possible with
the tows that each weaseler has to take
zebra patron builders can be sent immediately Nankin
Geo D Sheldon


Gen Butlers Hd Qrs May 28 1864
Maj Eckert Di
fanny harsh paddle unity mac & party will
report to Mr Sheldon at Jamestown this Evening
I send Homan & Collings with plank of
best large relays a pocket relay & portable
battery zebra not a moment has been lost
in carrying out you instructions as fully as
in our power hope all will work well 
R OBrien
